facts.fact: The Ministry of Information and Digitalization's Digital Readiness Assessment says that, building on its findings, "the next step is to develop Malawi's National Digital Transformation Strategy and Roadmap"; it reports no drafting under way or adoption, and the date is the document's own year (2025) as no event date is given.

systems.system: National Digital Transformation Strategy and Roadmap
systems.country_label: National Digital Transformation Strategy and Roadmap (also called National Digital Strategy and Roadmap)
systems.tiers: national; next steps call for policy and legal review, infrastructure, skills, e-government, cybersecurity, a multi-sectoral governance structure and monitoring and evaluation

systems.owner: Ministry of Information and Digitalization (cited as Malawi Government 2023)
systems.tiers: national; said to advocate open data initiatives and system integration across government agencies; period 2023-2028 as stated
named with the National Digitalization Policy as the initiatives supporting digital literacy; scope not described
named in the Principal Secretary's preface as an existing initiative; scope not described
named as providing mechanisms for citizen participation

systems.system: Digital Malawi Project / Digital Acceleration Project
systems.country_label: Digital Malawi Program and its successor Digital Acceleration Project
systems.owner: Government of Malawi, World Bank financed

systems.tiers: national; the assessment is aligned with it

note: The assessment cites the National Digitalization Policy 2023-2028, an ICT Master Plan and a Digital Economy Strategy as existing, with no adoption act, verb or scope, so no fact and class empty for those. Read from passages only. Its Next Steps section places the national strategy as still to be developed.
